name: LM311
description: The LM311 is a single high-speed voltage comparator that operates from a wide range of supplies, from a single 5V up to +/-15V split supplies, with a total supply voltage rating up to 36V. Its output stage brings out both the open-collector (COL OUT) and the emitter (EMIT OUT) of the output transistor independently, so it can drive loads referenced to ground or to a separate positive rail and interface to many logic families. It also provides BALANCE pins for input-offset trimming and a strobe (BAL/STRB) pin to force the output off on command. Typical uses include zero-crossing detectors, level detectors, oscillators, and driving relays or lamps directly.

pins.name: EMIT OUT
pins.description: emitter of output transistor, output emitter comparator

pins.name: BAL/STRB
pins.description: balance and strobe pin; pulling it forces the output off

pins.name: COL OUT
pins.description: collector of output transistor, open-collector output, needs external pullup

extra.supply_voltage: single 5V to 30V or +/-15V split; total supply 36V max
extra.output: open-collector (separate collector and emitter brought out)

typical_application: high-speed zero-crossing or level detection driving a ground- or rail-referenced load via the separately accessible collector and emitter output terminals.
gotchas: the open-collector COL OUT REQUIRES an external pullup resistor
both collector and emitter of the output transistor are brought out separately and must both be connected appropriately
the BAL/STRB strobe pin forces the output off when activated, watch for unintended strobing
total supply voltage across VCC+ and VCC- must not exceed 36V
input voltages must stay within the supply rails
